item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 12/Jul/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An anticyclone aloft will bring persistently very hot and generally fine weather to southern China in the next couple of days. With the anticyclone aloft weakening over the weekend, showers will increase gradually over the coast of Guangdong, but it will still be very hot. The area of low pressure now over the seas east of the Philippines may move across the vicinity of Luzon, enter the northeastern part of the South China Sea and develop gradually towards the weekend to early next week. The weather will be unsettled and windier over the coast of southern China early to midweek next week.
